# AI Career Packs — Free by Hyrenora

> 5 free AI-powered toolkits for job seekers. No fluff, no generic prompts — each pack is built around real gaps in what's out there.

---

## What's Inside

| Pack | What It Does |
|---|---|
| [🇮🇳 India Career OS](./01-india-career-os/) | Naukri optimization, Indian salary negotiation, campus-to-corporate |
| [📊 Non-Tech AI Playbook](./02-non-tech-ai-playbook/) | Marketing, Finance, Ops, HR, PM — roles engineers ignore |
| [🗺️ End-to-End Job Search Playbook](./03-end-to-end-job-search/) | Research → Apply → Interview → Negotiate → Onboard |
| [👻 Ghost Job & Scam Detection Kit](./04-ghost-job-scam-kit/) | Spot fake listings, ghost jobs, and recruitment scams before you apply |
| [🤖 MCP Prompt Pack](./05-mcp-prompt-pack/) | Use AI with live career data — Hyrenora + Claude.ai integration |

---

## Why These Packs Exist

Most AI career content online is the same recycled interview prompts. We looked at what's actually missing:

- **India-specific** guidance — salary benchmarks in INR, Naukri-specific optimization, cultural interview norms. Nothing good exists.
- **Non-tech roles** — 80% of AI career content is written for software engineers.
- **End-to-end arc** — most packs cover one stage. Nobody maps the full journey.
- **Ghost jobs** — 40% of job listings are ghost jobs. No existing resource teaches you to detect them with AI.
- **MCP workflows** — AI tools that connect to your actual career data, not just generic prompts.

---

## How to Use These

Each pack is a standalone markdown file — copy prompts directly into ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.

For the MCP pack: works best with [Hyrenora connected to Claude.ai](https://hyrenora.com/settings) — the AI has live access to your resume, skill gaps, and applications.

---
